mapper.select: SELECT e.*, o.id as oid, o.order_no, o.service_type, o.amount, u.id as uid, u.real_name, u.phone FROM evaluation e LEFT JOIN service_order o ON e.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN user u ON e.owner_id = u.id WHERE e.id = #{id}

SELECT e.*, o.id as oid, o.order_no, o.service_type, o.amount, u.id as uid, u.real_name, u.phone FROM evaluation e LEFT JOIN service_order o ON e.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN user u ON e.owner_id = u.id WHERE e.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT e.*, o.id as oid, o.order_no, o.service_type, o.amount, u.id as uid, u.real_name, u.phone FROM evaluation e LEFT JOIN service_order o ON e.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN user u ON e.owner_id = u.id WHERE e.owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY e.create_time DESC

SELECT e.*, o.id as oid, o.order_no, o.service_type, o.amount, u.id as uid, u.real_name, u.phone FROM evaluation e LEFT JOIN service_order o ON e.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN user u ON e.owner_id = u.id ORDER BY e.create_time DESC
SELECT ROUND(AVG(e.rating), 1) FROM evaluation e LEFT JOIN service_order o ON e.order_id = o.id WHERE o.mechanic_id = #{mechanicId} AND e.rating IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation(order_id, owner_id, rating, comment, create_time) VALUES(#{orderId}, #{ownerId}, #{rating}, #{comment}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT e.*, o.id as oid, o.order_no, o.service_type, o.amount, u.id as uid, u.real_name, u.phone FROM evaluation e LEFT JOIN service_order o ON e.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN user u ON e.owner_id = u.id ORDER BY e.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT rating, COUNT(*) as count FROM evaluation WHERE rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM evaluation WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
